# state status value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stateStatusValue`](gmeow-stateStatusValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateStatusValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The vitality status(es) asserted for the language during this state. NON-FUNCTIONAL: different authorities may assign different statuses for the same interval, and those claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
